name: Odyssey
creator: Homer
quote: "Men are so quick to blame the gods: they say[NEWLINE]that we devise their misery. But they[NEWLINE]themselves in their depravity design[NEWLINE]grief greater than the grief that fate assigns."

name: Fables
creator: Aesop
quote: "The tortoise plodded on and on. When the Hare awoke from his nap, he saw the Tortoise near the winning post. But he could not run fast enough in time to save the race. Then the Tortoise said, 'Slow and steady wins the race.'"

name: Oedipus the King
creator: Sophocles
quote: "Oedipus knew the famous riddles. He was a mighty king; he was the envy of everyone. Now he's struck a wave of terrible ruin. While you are alive, you must keep looking to your final day, and do not be happy 'til you pass life's boundary without suffering grief."

name: Lysistrata
creator: Aristophanes
quote: "You, man, are fool enough, it seems, to dare to war with women, when for your faithful ally you might win us easily."

name: Aeneid
creator: Virgil
quote: "It is easy to go down into Hell;[NEWLINE]night and day the gates of dark Death stand wide;[NEWLINE]but to climb back again, to retrace one's steps to the upper air -[NEWLINE]there's the rub, the task."

name: Metamorphoses
creator: Ovid
quote: "Happy is the man who has broken the chains which hurt the mind,[NEWLINE]and has given up worrying once and for all.[NEWLINE]Be patient and tough; one day this pain will be useful to you."

name: A True Story
creator: Lucian of Samosata
quote: "I fall back on falsehood - but falsehood of a most consistent variety; for I now make the only true statement you are to expect - that I am a liar. This defense is, I consider, a full defense against all imputations."

name: Rubaiyat
creator: Omar Khayyam
quote: "The Moving Finger writes; and, having writ,[NEWLINE]Moves on; nor all thy piety nor wit[NEWLINE]Shall lure it back to cancel half a line,[NEWLINE]Nor all thy tears wash out a word of it."

name: Masnavi
creator: Rumi
quote: "Knock, and He'll open the door.[NEWLINE]Vanish, and He'll make you shine like the sun.[NEWLINE]Fall, and He'll raise you to the heavens.[NEWLINE]Become nothing, and He'll turn you into everything."

name: Ramayama
creator: Valmiki
quote: "Valmiki the Poet held all the moving world inside a water drop in his hand.[NEWLINE]The gods and saints from Heaven looked down,[NEWLINE]And Valmiki looked down at the gods in the morning of Time."

name: Mahabharata
creator: Vyasa
quote: "To save the family, abandon a man;[NEWLINE]To save the village, abandon a family;[NEWLINE]To save the country, abandon a village;[NEWLINE]To save the soul, abandon the earth."

name: Urubhanga (The Broken Thigh)
creator: Bhasa
quote: "The disease of suspicion is never in my being.[NEWLINE]For I am a king who can respect the friendship[NEWLINE]That flowers between a man and a woman."

name: Abhijnanasakuntalam (Of Shantukala)
creator: Kalidasa
quote:
"Yesterday is but a dream;[NEWLINE]Tomorrow is only a vision.
But Today well lived makes every[NEWLINE]yesterday a dream of happiness;[NEWLINE]and every tomorrow a vision of hope."

name: Chu Ci (Songs of the South)
creator: Qu Yuan
quote: "Two monarchs then, who high renown received,[NEWLINE]followed the kingly way, their goal achieved.[NEWLINE]Two princes proud by lust their reign abused,[NEWLINE]sought easier path, and their own steps confused."

name: Shuihu Zhuan (Water Margin)
creator: Shi Nai'an
quote: "Today our younger brother, Chen Da, went against our advice. He offended Your Excellency and has been locked within your honorable manor. Since we have no way to save him, we have come to die with him."

name: Jin Ping Mei (The Plum in the Gold Vase)
creator: Lanling Xiaoxiao Sheng
quote: "The passions evoked by clouds and rain,[NEWLINE]joining their heads and twining their necks,[NEWLINE]within the bed curtains. Truly:[NEWLINE]When feelings converge, one is apt to forget[NEWLINE]what happens to a brocade girdle."

name: Hong Lou Meng (Dream of the Red Chamber)
creator: Cao Xueqin
quote: "The cunning waste their pains;[NEWLINE]The wise men vex their brains;[NEWLINE]But the simpleton, who seeks no gains,[NEWLINE]With belly full, he wanders free,[NEWLINE]As drifting boat upon the sea."

name: Kokin wakashu
creator: Ki no Tsurayuki
quote: "Argent pearls[NEWLINE]Did my tears seem[NEWLINE]Yet with the passing years[NEWLINE]Chinese crimson[NEWLINE]Have they become"

name: Genji monogatari (The Tale of Genji)
creator: Murasaki Shikibu
quote: "One ought not to be unkind to a woman merely on account of her plainness, any more than one had a right to take liberties with her merely because she was handsome."

name: Tsurezuregusa (Essays in Idleness)
creator: Yoshida Kenko
quote: "The most precious thing in life is its uncertainty. Leaving something incomplete makes it interesting and gives one the feeling that there is room for growth."

name: Shinjuten no Amijima (The Love Suicides of Amijima)
creator: Chikamatsu Monzaemon
quote: "To the ears of one possessed by the God of Death, reason and objections seem like so many idle complaints."

name: Ugetsu monogatari (Tales of Moonlight and Rain)
creator: Ueda Akinari
quote: "The moon glows on the river;[NEWLINE]Wind rustles the pine.[NEWLINE]Long night, clear evening -[NEWLINE]What are they for?"

name: Wagahai wa neko de aru (I am a Cat)
creator: Natsume Soseki
quote: "Living as I do with human beings, the more that I observe them, the more I am forced to conclude that they are selfish."

name: Don Quixote
creator: Miguel de Cervantes
quote: "'Now look, your grace,' said Sancho, 'what you see over there are not giants, but windmills, and what seems to be arms are just sails, that go around in the wind and turn the millstone.'[NEWLINE]'Obviously,' replied Don Quixote, 'you don't know much about adventures.'"

name: Maria
creator: Jorge Isaacs
quote: "I fell asleep sorrowful, filled with a vague foreboding of coming trouble. That lock of hair taken from a boy's head, that precaution of love against death, even in the presence of abounding life, caused my thoughts to wander all night about those scenes where I had passed, without knowing it, the happiest hours of my life."

name: Martin Fierro
creator: Jose Hernandez
quote: "I am a gaucho, and take this from me[NEWLINE]As my tongue explains it to you:[NEWLINE]For me the earth is a small place[NEWLINE]And could be bigger yet"

name: Azul
creator: Ruben Dario
quote: "Bagpipes of Spain, ye that can sing[NEWLINE]That which is sweetest to us in the Spring![NEWLINE]You first sing of gladness and then sing of pain[NEWLINE]As deep and as bitter as the billowed main."

name: Girart de Vienne
creator: Bertrand de Bar-sur-Aube
quote: "May God forbid the deed![NEWLINE]A King of France shall not be harmed by me![NEWLINE]If he forgives me, I'll be his man of liege,[NEWLINE]And hold from him all my lands in fief."

name: La Vie de Gargantua et de Pantagruel
creator: Francois Rabelais
quote: "Seeing how sorrow eats you, defeats you,[NEWLINE]I'd rather write about laughing than crying,[NEWLINE]For laughter makes men human, and courageous."

name: Candide, ou l'Optimisme
creator: Voltaire
quote: "Fools have a habit of believing that everything written by a famous author is admirable. For my part I read only to please myself and only what suits my taste."

name: Les Trois Mousquetaires (The Three Musketeers)
creator: Alexandre Dumas
quote: "All for one, one for all, that is our device."

name: Les Miserables
creator: Victor Hugo
quote: "The greatest happiness in life is the conviction that we are loved - loved for ourselves, or rather, loved in spite of ourselves ... To love another person is to see the face of God."

name: Vingt Mille Lieues sous les Mers (Twenty Thousand Leagues Under the Sea)
creator: Jules Verne
quote: "Captain Nemo pointed to this prodigious heap of shellfish, and I saw that these mines were genuinely inexhaustible, since Nature's creative powers are greater than Man's destructive instincts."

name: À la recherche du temps perdu (In Search of Lost Time)
creator: Marcel Proust
quote: "There is no man, however wise, who has not at some point in his youth said things, or lived a life, the memory of which is so unpleasant to him that he would gladly expunge it. And yet he ought not entirely regret it, because he cannot be certain that he has indeed become a wise man."

name: Divina Commedia (The Divine Comedy)
creator: Dante Alighieri
quote: "The hottest places in Hell are reserved for those who, in times of great moral crisis, maintain their neutrality."

name: Il Canzoniere (Song Book)
creator: Petrarch
quote: "How do you know, poor fool? Perhaps out there, somewhere, someone is sighing for your absence; and with this thought, my soul begins to breathe."

name: Orlando Furioso (The Frenzy of Orlando)
creator: Ludovico Ariosto
quote: "There never was such beauty in another man. Nature made him, and then broke the mold."

name: Saul
creator: Vittorio Alfieri
quote: "They shall record of thee, that David here[NEWLINE]Himself surrendered to ferocious Saul -[NEWLINE]March forth, O Israel, from thy peaceful tents;[NEWLINE]March forth from them, O King."

name: Die Rauber (The Robbers)
creator: Johann Friedrich von Schiller
quote: "Not that I have any doubt but that justice would find me speedily enough if the powers above so ordained it. But she might surprise me in sleep, or overtake me in flight, or seize me with violence and the sword, and then I should have lost the only merit left me, that of making my death a free-will atonement."

name: Faust: Der Tragodie
creator: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quote: "When scholars study a thing, they strive to kill it first, if it's alive; then they have the parts and the'be lost the whole, for the link that's missing was the living soul."

name: Revizor (The Government Inspector)
creator: Nikolai Gogol
quote: "It is no use to blame the looking glass if your face is awry."

name: Prestupleniye i Nakazaniye (Crime and Punishment)
creator: Fyodor Dostoyevsky
quote: "Pain and suffering are always inevitable for a large intelligence and a deep heart. The really great men must, I think, have great sadness on earth."

name: Voyna i Mir (War and Peace)
creator: Leo Tolstoy
quote: "You can love a person dear to you with a human love, but an enemy can only be loved with divine love."

name: Chayka (The Seagull)
creator: Anton Chekhov
quote: "Why do I hear a note of sadness that wrings my heart in this cry of a pure soul? If at any time you should have need of my life, come and take it."

name: Na dne (The Lower Depths)
creator: Maxim Gorky
quote: "Happiness always looks small while you hold it in your hands, but let it go, and you learn at once how big and precious it is."

name: The Canterbury Tales
creator: Geoffrey Chaucer
quote: "Yet do not miss the moral, my good men.[NEWLINE]For Saint Paul says that all that's written well[NEWLINE]Is written down some useful truth to tell.[NEWLINE]Then take the wheat and let the chaff lie still."

name: Le Morte D'Arthur (The Death of Arthur)
creator: Thomas Malory
quote: "Yet some men say in many parts of England that King Arthur is not dead, but had by the will of our Lord Jesus into another place; and men say that he shall come again."

name: The Faerie Queene
creator: Edmund Spenser
quote: "For there is nothing lost, that may be found, if sought."

name: Macbeth
creator: William Shakespeare
quote: "Life ... is a tale[NEWLINE]Told by an idiot, full of sound and fury,[NEWLINE]Signifying nothing."

name: Pride and Prejudice
creator: Jane Austen
quote: "I cannot fix on the hour, or the spot, or the look or the words, which laid the foundation. I was in the middle before I knew that I had begun."

name: Frankenstein
creator: Mary Shelley
quote: "Learn from me, if not by my precepts, at least by my example, how dangerous is the acquirement of knowledge, and how much happier that man is who believes his native town to be the world, than he who aspires to become greater than his nature will allow."

name: A Christmas Carol
creator: Charles Dickens
quote: "You may be an undigested bit of beef, a blot of mustard, a crumb of cheese, a fragment of underdone potato. There's more of gravy than of grave about you, whatever you are!"

name: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
creator: Lewis Carroll
quote: "'But I don't want to go among mad people,' Alice remarked.[NEWLINE]'Oh, you can't help that,' said the Cat. 'We're all mad here. I'm mad. You're mad.'[NEWLINE]'How do you know I'm mad?' said Alice.[NEWLINE]'You must be,' said the Cat, 'or you wouldn't have come here.'"

name: Barrack-Room Ballads
creator: Rudyard Kipling
quote: "And the first rude sketch that the world has seen[NEWLINE]was joy to his heart.[NEWLINE]Till the Devil whispered behind the leaves,[NEWLINE]'It's pretty, but is it art?'"

name: The Time Machine
creator: H.G. Wells
quote: "I think that at that time none of us quite believed in the Time Machine. The fact is, the Time Traveler was one of those men who are too clever to be believed: you never felt that you saw all around him; you always suspected some subtle reserve, some ingenuity in ambush, behind his lucid frankness."

name: The Sign of the Four
creator: Arthur Conan Doyle
quote: "Once you eliminate the impossible, whatever remains, no matter how improbable, must be the truth."

name: Lady Chatterley's Lover
creator: D.H. Lawrence
quote: "A woman has to live her life, or live to repent not having lived it."

name: The Sketch Book of Geoffrey Crayon, Gent.
creator: Washington Irving
quote: "And he would have passed a pleasant life of it, in despite of the Devil and all his works, if his path had not been crossed by a being that causes more perplexity to mortal man than ghosts, goblins, and the whole race of witches put together, and that was - a woman."

name: The Last of the Mohicans
creator: James Fenimore Cooper
quote: "Chingachgook grasped the hand that, in the warmth of feeling, the scout had stretched across the fresh earth, and in that attitude of friendship these intrepid woodsmen bowed their heads together, while scalding tears fell to their feet, watering the grave of Uncas like drops of falling rain."

name: The Raven and Other Poems
creator: Edgar Allan Poe
quote: "Open here I flung the shutter, when, with many a flirt and flutter,[NEWLINE]In there stepped a stately raven of the saintly days of yore.[NEWLINE]Not the least obeisance made he; not a moment stopped or stayed he;[NEWLINE]But, with mien of lord or lady, perched above my chamber door."

name: Twice-Told Tales
creator: Nathaniel Hawthorne
quote: "Amid the seeming confusion of our mysterious world, individuals are so nicely adjusted to a system, and systems to one another and to a whole, that, by stepping aside for a moment, a man exposes himself to a fearful risk of losing his place forever."

name: Moby Dick
creator: Herman Melville
quote: "Call me Ishmael. Some years ago - never mind how long precisely - having little or no money in my purse, and nothing particular to interest me on shore, I thought I would sail about a little and see the watery part of the world."

name: Uncle Tom's Cabin
creator: Harriet Beecher Stowe
quote: "Tom opened his eyes, and looked upon his master. 'Ye poor miserable critter!' he said, 'there ain't no more ye can do. I forgive ye, with all my soul!' and he fainted entirely away."

name: Walden
creator: Henry David Thoreau
quote: "I went to the woods because I wished to live deliberately, to front only the essential facts of life, and see if I could not learn what it had to teach, and not, when I came to die, discover that I had not lived."

name: Leaves of Grass
creator: Walt Whitman
quote:
"Oh Captain! My Captain! Our fearful trip is done,[NEWLINE]
The ship has weather'd every rack; the prize we sought is won."

name: Adventures of Huckleberry Finn
creator: Mark Twain
quote: "But I reckon I got to light out for the Territory ahead of the rest, because Aunt Sally she's going to adopt me and sivilize me, and I can't stand it. I been there before."

name: Poems
creator: Emily Dickinson
quote: "Because I could not stop for Death -[NEWLINE]He kindly stopped for me -[NEWLINE]The carriage held but just Ourselves -[NEWLINE]And Immortality."

name: The Red Badge of Courage
creator: Stephen Crane
quote: "He vaguely desired to walk around and around the body and stare; the impulse of the living to try to read in dead eyes the answer to the Question."

name: The Wonderful Wizard of Oz
creator: L. Frank Baum
quote: "'Oh - you're a very bad man!'[NEWLINE]'Oh no, my dear. I'm a very good man. I'm just a very bad Wizard.'"

name: The Great Gatsby
creator: F. Scott Fitzgerald
quote: "Gatsby believed in the green light, the orgastic future that year by year recedes before us. It eluded us then, but that's no matter - to-morrow we will run faster, stretch out our arms farther, and one fine morning..."
